svg.title: Scaling laws: balance model size and data
svg.desc: Loss follows power laws in model parameters N, data D, and compute. Under C≈6ND, Chinchilla found compute-optimal training scales N and D together at about D≈20N. Thresholded evaluation metrics can make smooth capability gains look like sudden emergence.

g.text: Scaling laws: balance model size and data
Chinchilla’s rule of thumb is about 20 training tokens per parameter.
Many earlier large models were under-trained.
SMOOTH POWER LAWS, NOT MAGIC JUMPS
Loss falls smoothly as N, D, and compute grow
For heavy inference, train a smaller model
